SHIONTHEBRUISER-MONSTER_ORB.title: Monster Orb
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MONSTER_ORB.description:
[gold]Passive:[/gold] At the start of your turn, for each enemy intent, gain:
Attack: [gold]Block[/gold].
Debuff: [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Counter Strategy[/gold].
Anything else: Energy.
[gold]Evoke:[/gold] Gain ALL of these once.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MONSTER_ORB.smartDescrip:
[gold]Passive:[/gold] At the start of your turn, for each enemy intent, gain:
Attack: [blue]{Passive}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Debuff: [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Counter Strategy[/gold].
Anything else: {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
[gold]Evoke:[/gold] Gain [blue]{Evoke}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Counter Strategy[/gold] and {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHIPPING_ORB.title: Shipping Orb
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHIPPING_ORB.description:
Gains [blue]1[/blue] Charge whenever a [gold]Request[/gold] completes or another Orb is [gold]Evoked[/gold]. [gold]Evokes[/gold] itself at [blue]5[/blue] Charges.
[gold]Evoke:[/gold] At the start of your next turn, draw [blue]5[/blue] cards, gain [blue]5[/blue] energy and [blue]5[/blue] Stars.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHIPPING_ORB.smartDescri:
Gains [blue]1[/blue] Charge whenever a [gold]Request[/gold] completes or another Orb is [gold]Evoked[/gold] ([blue]{Passive}[/blue]/5). [gold]Evokes[/gold] itself at [blue]5[/blue] Charges.
[gold]Evoke:[/gold] At the start of your next turn, draw [blue]{Evoke}[/blue] cards, gain [blue]{Evoke}[/blue] energy and [blue]{Evoke}[/blue] Stars.
